options.content: Data Factory Overview

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ADFPipelineRun
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Status == "Succeeded"
| summarize SuccessfulRuns = count()

ADFPipelineRun
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Status == "Failed"
| summarize FailedRuns = count()

ADFPipelineRun
| where $__timeFilter(Start)
| extend Predecessor = parse_json(Predecessors)[0]
| extend TriggerName = tostring(Predecessor.Name)
| extend TriggerType = tostring(Predecessor.InvokedByType)
| summarize TotalTriggers = dcount(RunId)

let SLAMinutes = 5.0;

let SubscriptionId = "262a3c1d-7fe3-4bfb-9f90-7a5b89109336";
let ResourceGroup = "Idea2.0";
let DataFactoryName = "pf-observability-datafactory";

let FactoryResourceId = strcat(
    "/subscriptions/", SubscriptionId,
    "/resourceGroups/", ResourceGroup,
    "/providers/Microsoft.DataFactory/factories/", DataFactoryName
);

let PipelineRuns =
    ADFPipelineRun
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Status in ("Succeeded", "Failed")
    | extend
        StartDateTime = todatetime(Start),
        EndDateTime = todatetime(End)
    | where isnotnull(StartDateTime) and isnotnull(EndDateTime)
    | extend DurationSeconds = datetime_diff(
        "second",
        EndDateTime,
        StartDateTime
    )
    | where DurationSeconds >= 0
    | extend DurationMinutes = round(
        todouble(DurationSeconds) / 60.0,
        2
    )
    | where DurationMinutes > 0;

let MaximumDurationByPipeline =
    PipelineRuns
    | summarize
        MaximumObservedDurationMinutes = max(DurationMinutes)
      by PipelineName;

PipelineRuns
| join kind=leftouter MaximumDurationByPipeline on PipelineName
| extend MaximumAllowedMinutes = SLAMinutes
| extend SLAStatus = case(
    DurationMinutes > SLAMinutes, "Breached",
    "Compliant"
)
| extend ADFUrl = strcat(
    "https://adf.azure.com/en/authoring/pipeline/",
    tostring(PipelineName),
    "?factory=",
    FactoryResourceId
)
| project
    PipelineName,
    RunId,
    Status,
    Start = StartDateTime,
    End = EndDateTime,
    DurationMinutes,
    MaximumObservedDurationMinutes,
    MaximumAllowedMinutes,
    SLAStatus,
    ADFUrl
| order by DurationMinutes desc

let SubscriptionId = "262a3c1d-7fe3-4bfb-9f90-7a5b89109336";
let ResourceGroup = "Idea2.0";
let DataFactoryName = "pf-observability-datafactory";

let FactoryResourceId = strcat(
    "/subscriptions/", SubscriptionId,
    "/resourceGroups/", ResourceGroup,
    "/providers/Microsoft.DataFactory/factories/", DataFactoryName
);

ADFPipelineRun
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where End > Start and Status == "Succeeded"
| extend DurationSeconds = datetime_diff(
    "second",
    todatetime(End),
    todatetime(Start)
)
| summarize
    LastRunInSeconds = max(DurationSeconds),
    AvgPastRunsInSeconds = avg(DurationSeconds)
  by PipelineName
| extend PercentDeviation = case(
    AvgPastRunsInSeconds > 0,
    round(
        ((LastRunInSeconds - AvgPastRunsInSeconds)
        / AvgPastRunsInSeconds) * 100.0,
        2
    ),
    0.0
)
| where PercentDeviation >= 10 or PercentDeviation <= -5
| extend ADFUrl = strcat(
    "https://adf.azure.com/en/authoring/pipeline/",
    tostring(PipelineName),
    "?factory=",
    FactoryResourceId
)
| project
    PipelineName,
    LastRunInSeconds,
    AvgPastRunsInSeconds = round(AvgPastRunsInSeconds, 2),
    PercentDeviation,
    ADFUrl
| order by PercentDeviation desc

let SubscriptionId = "262a3c1d-7fe3-4bfb-9f90-7a5b89109336";
let ResourceGroup = "Idea2.0";
let DataFactoryName = "pf-observability-datafactory";

let FactoryResourceId = strcat(
    "/subscriptions/", SubscriptionId,
    "/resourceGroups/", ResourceGroup,
    "/providers/Microsoft.DataFactory/factories/", DataFactoryName
);

ADFPipelineRun
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Status in ("Failed", "Succeeded")
| summarize arg_max(Start, Status, RunId, End) by PipelineName
| where Status == "Failed"
| join kind=leftouter (
    ADFActivityRun
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Status == "Failed"
    | summarize arg_max(
        Start,
        ActivityName,
        FailureType,
        ErrorMessage,
        ActivityIterationCount,
        LinkedServiceName,
        Output
      ) by PipelineRunId
    | extend OutputJson = parse_json(Output)
    | extend
        DataReadGB = iif(
            isnull(todouble(OutputJson.dataRead)),
            0.0,
            todouble(OutputJson.dataRead) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0
        ),
        DataWrittenGB = iif(
            isnull(todouble(OutputJson.dataWritten)),
            0.0,
            todouble(OutputJson.dataWritten) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0
        )
    | project
        PipelineRunId,
        ActivityName,
        ErrorType = FailureType,
        ErrorMessage,
        RetryCount = ActivityIterationCount,
        LinkedServiceName,
        DataReadGB,
        DataWrittenGB
) on $left.RunId == $right.PipelineRunId
| extend Duration = datetime_diff(
    "second",
    todatetime(End),
    todatetime(Start)
)
| extend PointOfFailure = coalesce(
    ActivityName,
    LinkedServiceName
)
| extend DataVolumeProcessed = DataReadGB + DataWrittenGB
| extend CostImpact = DataVolumeProcessed * 0.05
| extend ADFUrl = strcat(
    "https://adf.azure.com/en/authoring/pipeline/",
    tostring(PipelineName),
    "?factory=",
    FactoryResourceId
)
| project
    PipelineName,
    RunId,
    Status,
    Start,
    End,
    Duration,
    ActivityName,
    ErrorType,
    ErrorMessage,
    PointOfFailure,
    RetryCount,
    DataVolumeProcessed,
    CostImpact,
    ADFUrl
| order by Start desc

let SubscriptionId = "262a3c1d-7fe3-4bfb-9f90-7a5b89109336";
let ResourceGroup = "Idea2.0";
let DataFactoryName = "pf-observability-datafactory";

let FactoryResourceId = strcat(
    "/subscriptions/", SubscriptionId,
    "/resourceGroups/", ResourceGroup,
    "/providers/Microsoft.DataFactory/factories/", DataFactoryName
);

ADFActivityRun
| where $__timeFilter(End)
| extend
    StartDateTime = todatetime(Start),
    EndDateTime = todatetime(End)
| where isnotnull(StartDateTime) and isnotnull(EndDateTime)
| extend duration_sec = datetime_diff(
    "second",
    EndDateTime,
    StartDateTime
)
| where duration_sec >= 0
| summarize arg_max(duration_sec, *) by PipelineName
| top 10 by duration_sec desc
| extend ADFUrl = strcat(
    "https://adf.azure.com/en/authoring/pipeline/",
    tostring(PipelineName),
    "?factory=",
    FactoryResourceId
)
| project
    PipelineName,
    End = EndDateTime,
    duration_sec,
    ActivityType,
    ActivityRunId,
    ActivityName,
    Status,
    ADFUrl
| order by duration_sec desc

ADFPipelineRun
| extend SysParams = parse_json(SystemParameters)
| extend RequestTime = todatetime(SysParams.PipelineRunRequestTime)
| extend QueuedDurationSeconds = case(
    Status == "Queued" and isnull(End), datetime_diff('second', now(), Start),  // Still queued
    Status in ("Succeeded", "Failed") and isnotnull(RequestTime), datetime_diff('second', Start, RequestTime),  // Completed
    long(null)
)
| where QueuedDurationSeconds > 0  // Filter out zero or null (commenting for testing)
| project PipelineName, RunId, Status, Start, End, QueuedDurationSeconds
| order by QueuedDurationSeconds desc

ADFPipelineRun
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Status in ("Succeeded", "Failed")
| extend DurationMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', End, Start)
| where DurationMinutes > 4
| project PipelineName, RunId, Status, Start, End, DurationMinutes
| order by DurationMinutes desc
